# CSI 2-008 — Modal plate / diagonal CONM2

Independent accuracy compares each solver with the same supplied CSI/analytical observable. Missing references and unverified normalization remain PENDING. Nastran–MYSTRAN differences are not accuracy metrics. Zero references use absolute residuals. Numerical data are retained locally; public tables embed the compared values.

Only diagonal CONM2 mass variants are included. Supplied independent periods T=[0.01723, 0.00704, 0.00281, 0.00219, 0.00193]s; frequencies are1/T. Values are frequency-order comparisons, not claims of matching CSI eigenvectors/MAC. Multiple mesh levels use connected lines with distinct markers/dashes; reference ratio=1,error threshold=1%.
